verdict.rationale: The only built-in background automation is auto-renew, which is on by default and renews domains without user action. Building anything else would mean scripting against the Registrar API (with an OpenAPI spec and an official MCP server available) and running it on your own external scheduler or agent. missing for 10: user-configurable automations or scheduled jobs inside the product, event triggers or webhooks, documented autonomous agent workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.
